## Distributive · Multiply each term {#fv1-distributive .fv-lesson }

```{=html}
<p>Multiplication <strong>distributes over addition</strong>: multiply each term in the sum.</p><div class="fv-equation"><span data-math="\displaystyle \textcolor{#217864}{2}(\textcolor{#ad6e32}{3}+\textcolor{#315985}{4})=\textcolor{#217864}{2}\times\textcolor{#ad6e32}{3}+\textcolor{#217864}{2}\times\textcolor{#315985}{4}"></span></div><div class="fv-equation"><span data-math="\displaystyle \textcolor{#217864}{a}(\textcolor{#ad6e32}{b}+\textcolor{#315985}{c})=\textcolor{#217864}{a}\textcolor{#ad6e32}{b}+\textcolor{#217864}{a}\textcolor{#315985}{c}"></span></div><div class="fv-equation"><span data-math="\displaystyle (\textcolor{#217864}{a}+\textcolor{#ad6e32}{b})(c+d)=\textcolor{#217864}{a}c+\textcolor{#217864}{a}d+\textcolor{#ad6e32}{b}c+\textcolor{#ad6e32}{b}d"></span></div>
```

<div class="booklet-cue">Booklet §1.1 · p. 1</div>

::: {.notes}
About two minutes. The multiplying factor keeps its colour each time it is distributed. In the final identity, colour a and b to track the two sets of products. Keep the arithmetic brief. All results are visible, with no reveal buttons.
:::
